about_the_game:
What is required for deduction?

Scientific evidence, eyewitness testimony, and objective facts.
By interlocking these elements, the final remaining “possibility” becomes the truth.

So declared the great detective Holmes—
or rather, my grandfather.

This is an episode recounting an inexplicable case that □□ and I encountered.
There is no such thing as the impossible.
Evidence always speaks the truth.

🔹 Synopsis

You awaken in an unfamiliar office.
□□ has lost their memory.

At your side is a woman who calls herself a Consulting Private Detective,
and she appears to know who □□ is.

Why was your memory lost?
What is this office?
And was this encounter truly a coincidence?

By piecing together fragmented testimonies and facts,
you gradually approach the truth behind the incident—and your lost memories.

🔹 Game Details

Genre

  • Mystery / Investigation (Beginner-friendly)

  • Detective

  • Story-branching Visual Novel

  • Yuri elements included

Estimated Playtime

  • Single playthrough: 2–4 hours

  • All routes completed: 5+ hours

Playtime may vary depending on choices, reading speed, and play style.

Difficulty

  • Casual

  • Accessible to players new to mystery and deduction games

Features

  • A detective mystery driven by evidence and testimony

  • Story branches that change based on player choices

  • A narrative that examines cases through both logic and emotion

🔹 Main Heroine

Japanese Name: Yaka Sherok
English Name: Sherok Holmes

Profile

  • Height: 158 cm

  • Weight: 48 kg

  • Blood Type: AB

  • Birthday: January 6 (Age 27)

  • Gender: Female

  • Occupation: Consulting Private Detective

Occupation: Consulting Private Detective

The only consulting private detective officially retained by the police in Japan.

Born in London, she graduated top of her class from the University of Cambridge Graduate School of Law, specializing in forensic science.

She was formerly affiliated with the UK branch of the Pinkerton Detective Agency.

An expert in psychology, anthropology, and forensics, she has solved numerous complex and high-profile cases.

Public records suggest she is a descendant of the Holmes lineage.

At first glance, she may appear easygoing and carefree.

However, beneath that demeanor lies an unwavering pride as a guardian of law and order.

Also known as:

  • SHEROK’s Memory Archive
    (Traditional Chinese / 繁體中文)

  • SHEROK’s Memory Archive
    (Simplified Chinese / 简体中文)

  • Sherok-ui Gieok Sageonrok
    (Korean / 한국어)

  • Le Dossier de SHEROK ; Réminiscence
    (French / Français)

AI Usage Notice:

This game uses AI-generated text in part of its branching narrative.

The branching story content is generated by AI

based on structures, design, and supervision created by the human developer.

Additionally, AI-assisted translation is used for part of the multilingual localization process.

Please note that

the worldbuilding, main scenario structure, character design, background artwork, and Live2D assets

are all created entirely by a human developer.
